name: koskita
description: KosKita: super app kecil untuk mahasiswa anak kos (Dompet, Patungan, Kuliah)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/backend install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:mobile
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run lint
